scientific_integrity: General theorem proved by explicit projective reduction and exact rank criteria. Finite computational verification is corroborative, not an all-parameter certificate. No new code construction or improved decoding speed is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classical subline and Steiner design parameters are prior art. The claimed refinements identify the support geometry and optimize pairwise-disjoint three-helper recovery in characteristic three. A possible equivalent implicit geometric-coding argument in other older literature remains a priority risk. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Projective-subline rigidity and optimal three-helper availability in a rank-four code family
